findings.claim: results.md misstates two iteration-1 counts. It says the two pages re-checked as holds (lifecycle, release) missed nothing, but the iteration-2 verification found REAL drift on both pages (lifecycle fixing->verifying labelled narrow round; release bundle job leaves out check_okf.py). It also says the baseline called 9 pages drifted, but one of the 9 is index.md, which is not a concept, so the baseline called 8 of 10 pages drifted.
